title: A/P Detail: Date and Due Date read as dates, never Today or Yesterday
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin user (the "Admin" role).
  • Have a vendor with three open bills, each due 30 days after its own date: bill A dated today, bill B dated yesterday and bill C dated 2 days ago.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 px wide.
  • Open A/P Detail (Reports, then "A/P Aging Detail" under ACCOUNTS PAYABLE in the left menu).
  • Leave the report with only that vendor ticked in the Vendor filter.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Bill A, bill B and bill C are listed.
  • Their Date cells read today's date, yesterday's date and the date of 2 days ago as month, day and year (for example "Nov 10, 2026").
  • Their Due Date cells read dates in the same form.
  • No Date or Due Date cell reads "Today", "Yesterday" or "2 days ago".

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 11 (5 Nov 2026, Chris Ward), read 10 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11532 (Story 2, Sort by clicking any column header)

  • S2-R1a: “Date and Due Date show plain dates on screen, for example "Nov 4, 2026". The PDF and the CSV keep their own date formats (S3-R7a, S3-R8). They never read "Today", "Yesterday" or "2 days ago".”
  • What changes for existing users: “Date and Due Date show plain dates, for example "Nov 4, 2026", instead of "Today", "Yesterday" or "2 days ago" (S2-R1a).”

Not yet checked against a build: the QA build v26.45.2-6a8b89c exists since 10 Nov 2026 and this case has not been run on it yet.

Design canvas "A/R and A/P Report Sorting" (https://claude.ai/artifact/BRYCdjKwGRSgGPC9xxkgF4), version of 5 Nov 2026 (1793886208-34e0), read 10 Nov 2026: page 1 "Opening order and header sorting" (board Main.dc.html).
